journey.name: receive through primary quote
journey.description: Requires a compatible Beignet or LDK Node primary on the same regtest chain, connected through the Primary node screen, with sufficient provider funds and no inbound channel in Bitkit. Repeat for each provider. The provider must support receive quotes and skim authorization. Use a disposable provider whose available funds and receive limits can be changed for refusal checks. Use regtest funds only. This Android flow is not implemented on iOS yet.

actions.action: Open Receive and verify the Bitcoin tab (testTag "Tab-auto") shows an onchain QR
Request a Lightning amount too small to cover the provider receive fee and verify the error asks for a larger amount, with no fee approval or Lightning invoice available

Request more than the disposable primary can fund and verify the error explains that the primary lacks funds for this amount, suggests a smaller request or funding the primary, and keeps Bitcoin address receiving available
Reduce the request to an amount the provider can fund and retry; verify the error clears and a fresh receive fee is offered without automatically creating a Lightning invoice
Go back to amount entry before continuing the approved receive flow
Tap Create Lightning request (testTag "PrimaryReceiveRequest"), enter an amount and tap Review receive fee (testTag "ContinueAmount")

Repeat amount entry in a compact 360 by 640 dp viewport and verify the full Review receive fee button remains above the navigation bar, below the keypad; tapping its center must open the fee review without changing the entered amount
Verify the fee review (testTag "PrimaryReceiveConfirm") shows the requested amount, maximum fee (testTag "PrimaryReceiveFee") and minimum received (testTag "PrimaryReceiveMinimum")

On the compact viewport, scroll the fee details and verify Approve remains fully visible; after a failed request, verify the error can scroll while Retry and Approve remain visible and Approve is disabled
Before approving, verify no Lightning invoice is displayed or available to copy
Go back, change the amount and request a new quote; verify the fee review uses the new amount
Approve (testTag "PrimaryReceiveApprove") and verify the Bitcoin QR contains the onchain address, exact approved amount and a Lightning invoice
Copy the request and pay its Lightning invoice from a separate funded regtest wallet; mine the provider-required blocks if a channel opens
Verify the payment appears once in activity and the one Bitcoin balance increases by the received amount after the quoted fee

Open the received activity and verify its header shows the net amount credited and its fee shows the actual amount withheld; refresh and restart the app and verify the same receipt remains once without changing either amount
Verify the settled Lightning invoice disappears from QR, details, copy and share without generating a paid replacement
Request and approve another regtest invoice, keep Receive open until the invoice expires and verify its Lightning request disappears without automatic approval or an extra provider charge
Request and approve another invoice, pay the onchain fallback address and verify the merged request clears after wallet synchronization

Request and approve another invoice, disconnect the primary and wait for the next native wallet sync without manually refreshing; verify its Lightning request is unavailable in QR, details, copy and share while the onchain address remains available
Open Receive again, edit the amount and note and verify the new QR never reuses the previously approved invoice

At 360 by 640 dp, tap the invoice editor amount, enter a value, and verify its Continue button (testTag "ReceiveNumberPadSubmit") is fully visible below the keypad; tapping its center returns to note editing without changing the value
Stop the provider, request another quote and verify an inline error with a retry path appears while Bitcoin onchain receiving remains available

Restart the same provider and retry the quote; verify the error clears and the new fee requires explicit approval before a usable Lightning invoice appears, without manual refresh or reopening Receive

On a new receive, reduce the disposable provider funds after reviewing the fee but before approving; verify approval shows the insufficient primary funds message and cannot expose an invoice or submit another approval until a fresh quote succeeds
Fund the disposable provider, retry the quote and verify its current fee is displayed; explicitly approve it and verify a usable invoice appears

In a fresh wallet with the same provider, deposit 50,000 regtest sats and confirm automatic primary channel opening; then request and approve a 100,000 sat receive, pay it from a separate wallet and verify channel growth settles a payment larger than the original channel capacity, with one net credit and the approved fee

For an older channel created before splice-compatible limit negotiation, request more than its original negotiated limit and verify no primary invoice is issued; explicitly close and reopen it before repeating the larger receive
